title: Media
lede: What the mood boards and the song folders hold. The star makes a picture the song's own (Ctrl+Z undoes it); nothing is moved on your disk.
none: No media found: no picture, video, font or preset in the song folders or their mood boards.
coverUnset: Chosen picture: click to go back to the app's choice

audio.lede: The audio files of song folders that no song uses: not a reference render, not a sample a project plays, not a reference track. Often a render the app did not link by its name: link it as the reference render. Nothing is moved on your disk.
audio.doneBoard: {name} is on the mood board of {title}.

loose.lede: The pictures, videos, sounds and notes of folders with no project, outside your song folders (the same as the Folders view's "Media outside projects" panel). Tick several to send them at once to a song's, a release's or an artist's mood board. Nothing is moved on your disk.
